status.zh: 在幫曬日子抓 bug，順便偷拍下一支短片
status.en: Squashing bugs in 曬日子 and sneaking in the next short film

post.zh:
剪到第 9 版，終於定稿 😮‍💨
曬日子的新短片《年度最佳貼文》：你隨手發的一篇日常，被頒了年度大獎。
post.en:
Nine cuts later, it's finally done 😮‍💨
New 曬日子 short film, "Post of the Year": your random everyday post wins the big award.
